proof_scope: Offline schemas and conformance only; new implementation, Nibbler hardware, restart, recovery and release proof owed. P5-T35 Beast proof is unchanged.

acceptance.scenario: clean installation and idempotent rerun use persistent Linux Compose without Apptainer; real owner-to-sibling host-loopback connectivity is proven before GPU qualification
mixed Pascal/Turing inventory retains per-card stable identities across reordering and reboot, and the pinned compatible runtime executes on every qualified card
unnegotiated or unenrolled peers cannot provision; idle hardware and control status never advertise serving offers
automatic policy-scoped qualification runs verified artifacts through real authorization, admission, correctness, context and cancellation/reuse checks before readiness

throughput drafts, missing or expired evidence, fingerprint drift, absent attestation, stale status, unhealthy watchdog or quarantine cannot publish through adoption or settle; permits enforce exact identity, scope, expiry and atomic request budgets
distinct deployments use disjoint homogeneous groups; a second assignment for an identical deployment is refused before executor translation and never becomes an implicit span
elective stop/replacement drains before unload and preserves healthy-instance floors; severe faults immediately withdraw unsafe capacity and expose any floor deficit
bounded rescue preserves actual known-good artifacts, never invents a rollback target, and persists exhausted attempts and quarantine across node and gateway restart

real subprocess SIGTERM, SIGINT and graceful owner drop preserve attested containers and durable claims for adoption; explicit retirement withdraws, drains and unloads; host reboot preserves identity and avoids duplicate engines
gateway restart reconciles durable holdings and qualification evidence after a fresh report, invalidates prior permits and requires a fresh full-path probe before publication
managed link-only inference and cancellation work through reconnect without duplicated placement or exposed unauthenticated engine ports

exact-commit and digest-pinned Nibbler installation/restart/recovery evidence, independent review and required checks pass before normal merge; offline contract tests never substitute for runtime or hardware proof
